entries.hypothesis: One of the 33 curated R12-C2 mysticism/philosophy texts, used as a letters-only RUNNING KEY (sliding at some start offset) over an unsolved LP2 page, decodes it under the skip-aware beam (keyskip1 exact and/or keyskip2 skip_by_two-exact). This is R12-C2's staged-but-never-executed keytext sweep, finally run.
entries.threshold: hitfn20 3-clause: pmax >= panelmax20 family-wise bar AND rune-index recovery >= 0.90 AND held-out 3/4 reproduction; score alone never certifies; any bar-clearing survivor is FLAGGED-FOR-ORACLE, never auto-solved (R21-L1).
entries.positive_control: control.py plants plotinus_enneads_mackenna.txt as the running key over English self_reliance (L=240, 7 seeds, random keytext offsets), enciphered under BOTH keyskip1 and skip_by_two filters; the matched skip-aware presets recover it at median/min = 1.000/1.000 rune-index recovery (control.json). CONTROL_PASSED=True. Null is from a validated instrument.
entries.result: 0 / 1,562 measured decodes clear the panel-max bar. 0 HITs, 0 flagged-for-oracle. Best decode pmax=5.470 (theologia_germanica, preset pair, page 23, register EN_KJV) vs family-wise bar 5.732 -- 0.262 below its own bar; nothing on any completed page approaches a clear. Language-agnostic channels all read as noise: median IoC*N ~1.0, median mds ~15/29, median h2 ~4.79 bits. off8 (double offset density, pages 19-20) reproduces the null exactly. NOTE: for a rigid running key the held-out self-consistency clause is non-discriminating (median heldout=1.000); the panel-max bar is the real gate and it is 0/1,562.
entries.coverage: 33 R12-C2 texts x (4 offsets/text primary; 8 offsets/text on pages 19-20 corroborator) x 9 unsolved rune-pages x 2 presets (keyskip1, keyskip2), sign=-1. 1,562 decodes measured. Pages COMPLETE at 4 offsets/text: 19, 26, 28 (page 19 also at 8 offsets); page 23 to 86% (199/232); page 20 a thin off8 slice (43). off4 feasible plan run: 991/2,184 = 45.4%. Every decode persists language-agnostic stats (pmax,bar,ioc,mds,h2,distinct,pmax_ne,9-register z,score,recovery,heldout) in sweep.jsonl / sweep_partial_off8.jsonl.
not_covered: Large pages CAPPED under multi-lane CPU contention and left UN-SWEPT: page 20 (mostly), 22, 25, 27, 29 (1,729-3,008 runes). Identical-in-kind cheap re-run for a future compute lane -- same instrument, same texts, just slower.
sign=+1 (only sign=-1 swept); offset densities >8/text; reversed texts; texts outside this 33-text corpus; per-line / per-page key restarts.

The 4 truncated 5,336-rune texts (achad_qbl, alghazali_alchemy_happiness, emerald_tablet_hermetic, sepher_yetzirah_westcott) cannot span the longest pages as a full running key -- those (text,page) cells are UNCOVERABLE by a running key, not merely un-run.
permissive drift decoder (lam=12), multi-rune correlated errors, transpositions -- the transition model here is keyskip1 + keyskip2 only.
entries.reproduce: cd analysis/round26/B && python3 control.py && python3 sweep.py && python3 finalize.py  (control.json proves recovery=1.00; sweep.jsonl holds per-decode rows; finalize.py rebuilds sweep_summary.json + honest per-page coverage from whatever rows completed).
entries.notes: EXTENDS R12-C2 ('Texts fetched (29 files ~12 MB); the sweep was never run', not_covered:None) -- the never-run keytext sweep is now run and validated. Distinct from R12-A1 (those swept the 6 AUTHOR PADS as literal byte->symbol reductions into the RIGID stream, not letters-only running keys into the skip-aware decoder). Consumes the 'sha256_ctr keytexts' item that R24-C2-EXT-SKIP-GENERATORS explicitly left open in its not_covered. Reuses driftbeam presets exact/pair + hitfn20 + panelmax20 verbatim; no instrument rebuilt.
